strategy.rationale: Use direct authoritative world and run-lifecycle restoration instead of prior fixture/evidence-only treatments. Repair the real upgrade-draft visual hierarchy as a player-facing capability, while retaining dense profiling as an isolated host handoff rather than repeating an unavailable renderer treatment.

code: Run focused Godot parse/static checks on the modified route, spatial, lifecycle, upgrade-draft, HUD, and dense-handoff files.
Verify ordinary progression is monotonic and authoritative, terminal commit is exactly once, Retry clears run-owned state, and tester-only actions are excluded from release exports.

Verify upgrade projections equal applied modifiers, card eligibility is truthful, focus neighbors are complete, and dense receipts retain renderer/sample/cycle/reset fields without changing ordinary gameplay timing.
runtime: GameLoop Runtime/Tester should recapture title-to-spawn, ordinary movement replay, critical route, central building/landmark, perimeter/boundary, five-wave/Bellkeeper transition, Result, and three clean Retry cycles.
Recapture the real three-card draft at open, keyboard focus, mouse hover, gamepad navigation, confirm, and return-to-gameplay states using authoritative offer/selection receipts.

Run dense prepare -> advance -> reset serially for three cycles on eligible native hardware at 1920x1080; retain llvmpipe as rejected software evidence if native hardware is unavailable, then rerun both required release checks and preserved boot/integrity checks.
visual: Sparse shipped-camera views must show larger traversable authored cemetery space, coherent external world/external depth, stable central building/landmark, aligned collision at the perimeter/boundary, and no disappearance or occlusion during ordinary movement.

Compare retest captures to the bound Mournlight reference for moonlit blue-violet shadows, warm lantern hierarchy, readable escape lanes, and clear combat/HUD separation.
